title: Career Opportunities
intro: Successful completion of a relevant programme can support learners in pursuing opportunities related to their area of training, subject to the eligibility requirements of individual institutions and employers.

roles.title: Montessori / Preschool Teacher
roles.text: Lead child-centred classrooms in Montessori and early years settings.

roles.title: Early Childhood Educator
roles.text: Support holistic development in nurseries and daycare centres.

roles.title: Assistant Teacher
roles.text: Assist lead teachers in primary and pre-primary classrooms.

roles.title: Phonics Educator
roles.text: Specialise in early literacy and reading enrichment programmes.

roles.title: Special Education Support
roles.text: Work as shadow teachers and inclusive classroom aides.

roles.title: School Administration
roles.text: Manage academic and operational functions in schools.

roles.title: Preschool Coordinator
roles.text: Coordinate curriculum, staff and parent engagement.

roles.title: Education Entrepreneur
roles.text: Start and manage your own preschool or training centre.
